title: Guru, The Perfect True Guru, Is My
summary: The shabad does not leave loneliness at diagnosis. It turns toward return.
takeaway: The Guru, the Perfect True Guru, is my Mother and Father. Obtaining the Water
lifeApplication: Name the companionship the line is restoring before the mind insists it is alone. After the reaction, make the next return smaller and truer.

source.shortMeaning: The Guru, the Perfect True Guru, is my Mother and Father. Obtaining the Water; i am a helpless child-please cherish me
source.lifeApplication: Name the companionship the line is restoring before the mind insists it is alone. Let this line guide the first honest return after the reaction.
